headline: Sri Lanka stocks close down 1.37-pct, dragged by Commercial Bank, HNB
summary: The Colombo Stock Exchange closed lower on Wednesday, with the All Share Price Index down 1.37% to 21,402.76. The S&P SL20 fell 1.46%, with Commercial Bank and HNB among the drags.
why: The All Share Price Index tracks the broad market of the Colombo Stock Exchange. Major banks such as Commercial Bank and HNB carry significant weight in Sri Lankan equity performance.
